newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ASX substantial shareholding notices - Feb 7.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ASX substantial shareholding notices - Feb 7.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices have been made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).
